newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: BRIDGESTONE SAID BUYING IN SINGAPORE RUBBER MARKET.
newsitem.headline: BRIDGESTONE SAID BUYING IN SINGAPORE RUBBER MARKET.

text.p: Bridgestone was said to have bought some TSR20 rubber on Wednesday in the Singapore rubber market although currency turmoil in Southeast Asia and the 'Obon' holidays in Japan kept the tone quiet, dealers said.
"Bridgestone probably bought some TSR20 rubber," a dealer said. Another trader added: "They were looking for forward delivery of TSR20 rubber."
Michelin was also said to have asked for some quotes for RSS3 rubber while other players were engaged in small-lot shortcovering in the market, dealers said.
"The currency turmoil in this region is making it difficult for producers. They are very jittery about concluding any deals because currency rates may change quickly," a dealer said.

Another trader said the 'Obon' holiday period in Japan, coupled with the currency problems, kept most of the trade sitting on the sidelines. "There were no fireworks in the market today," a dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, December TSR20 was seen at 97.50 U.S. cents a kg from 98.25 cents.
